Exclusive local receipt path avoids overwriting prior admission

Positive free-disk threshold and no Docker containers observed before/after reader
VMboot/uptime/CPU/memory identity fields exclude process args and environment

limitations.detail: Dataset manifest hash/count metadata is recorded, not checked against an expected dataset hash. Does not rehash canonical input files. Root must compare baseline manifest and subsequent graph receipt.
Docker snapshots only; not all VM processes. No lock, no future idle guarantee, no complete-run memory/disk guarantee.
Binary stat bracket is a narrow concurrent-change guard, not lock. Dataset/native hash reads do not have equivalent stat brackets.

If docker run times out, subprocess.run terminates client but does not prove unnamed reader container termination; --rm removes on eventual exit. Before proceeding after that failure, identify and reap only the reader via Docker; no timeout occurred in this review because reviewer did not run it.

approval_scope: Bounded read-only preflight suitable as supplementary observation with listed interpretation/failure-cleanup limits
